svg.text: Same skeleton. More everyday life.
01 Shared access, small destinations
Connect entrances with narrow paths.
Short access lanes, a few parked cars,
bins near access points, benches by doors.
02 Four courts, four identities
A1: play area and a quiet lawn.
B1: ball court and carpet-beating rails.
A2: informal paths through a wild reserve.
B2: temporary beds and a meeting spot.
03 Public buildings get front + back
Small paved entrance courts toward the axis.
Green side areas and rear service parking.
Keep the existing buildings and lot boundaries.
04 Keep breathing room
School / kindergarten core reserves stay open
to future development. No new permanent blocks.
Leave clear space around request markers.
LEGEND
Existing buildings
Proposed paths / small paved courts
Proposed planting / usable green space
Dashed: retained core / lot boundaries
DESIGN PROPOSAL · Not an approved map change
Roads and lot positions follow district_layout.gd. Furniture, vegetation and paths are schematic; no gameplay files changed.
